info.name: Instant Mechanic — Stateless API Security Collection

description.content:
Postman v2.1 collection for the Instant Mechanic stateless multimodal API.

Covers the normal chat -> diagnosis -> booking flow, prompt-injection payloads, in-memory PII masking checks, spoofed/oversized image uploads and slowapi rate-limit bursts.

No accounts, no tokens, no database state: run the folders in any order. `Normal Diagnosis` seeds the `sessionId` collection variable used by the upload requests.

Base URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000. For the proxy walkthrough see docs/BURP_SUITE_CHECKLIST.md.
